name: What preparatory steps should I take before an ADU kitchen installation begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparatory steps should I take before an ADU kitchen installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an ADU kitchen installation begins, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your design preferences, budget, and desired timeline. You should also ensure the ADU structure is ready for interior work, including framing and rough-ins for plumbing and electrical. Gathering inspiration photos, making a list of must-have features, and deciding on appliance types will help streamline the design phase. We also recommend having a temporary living arrangement if the ADU is already occupied, as the kitchen will be non-functional during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, finalize design preferences, set a budget, ensure ADU structure readiness, and plan for temporary living arrangements if occupied.
